The Wall

A climbing wall hangs in a starlit void, lit by a single spotlight that follows you up. The first handholds are ordinary gym holds. After that, the holds become objects from a life: a rattle, toy blocks, a crayon, a baseball, a cassette, a graduation cap, car keys, a wedding ring, a coffee mug, a framed photo. Higher up they turn to a pill bottle, a hospital bracelet, wilted flowers, a sympathy card, and finally an urn holding your mother's ashes. The light cools and narrows as you climb. When you take hold of the urn, you fall.

How to climb: tap or click the hold with the ring behind it (or press Space). Drag to look around. In a headset, look at the hold or pull the trigger.

How it was made: the sky is the A-Frame Environment Component's starry preset with its ground, fog and lighting turned off so the wall stays in a void. The wall, all 19 handholds, the scattered gym holds and the objects drifting in the dark (an upside-down chair, a door, a clock with no hands) were modeled and arranged in three.js and exported with its GLTFExporter as one file, models/the-wall.glb.
